vb_textbox.text: Well this is going to be difficult as my advise is not going to help you very much. Except to say that you should exercise your fingers for a couple of minutes before you start as this goes on for a long long time and your fingers are going to get stiff. As far as the game is concerned, be quick or you'll miss the timer. I couldn't see any advantage in picking one or the other. There were good scores both sides. I didn't notice a pattern even going for the same side 10/15 times or doing alternate, it didn't seem to make any difference but you can't tell as you never see 'what you would have won'. I did try to glance at the background to see if there were any indications of which side would be best, but it really was too quick and I missed the timer once doing this, so gave it up. In summary, pick random and do it fast so you don't miss any.
